sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'I scream Ice Cream Match3 Fun' is a match-three puzzle game where you're tasked with matching ice creams of the same color to clear them from the board. The game features a 6x6 grid, and you can swap two adjacent ice creams to create a match. As you clear ice creams, new ones will drop from the top of the grid, giving you a sense of urgency and excitement. The game becomes increasingly challenging as you progress through levels, with new obstacles and power-ups introduced to keep you on your toes.

One of the unique features of 'I scream Ice Cream Match3 Fun' is its power-up system. As you clear ice creams, you'll unlock bigger and better power-ups, including the coveted Rainbow Popsicle. These power-ups can be used to clear large areas, destroy obstacles, or even freeze certain ice creams to prevent them from moving. The key to success lies in strategically planning your moves and using your power-ups wisely.

Another essential aspect of the game is its scoring system. The game rewards you for clearing ice creams in a single move, using special power-ups, and completing levels within a certain time limit. As you progress through levels, the scoring requirements become increasingly difficult, and you'll need to develop strategies to meet these requirements while still clearing the ice creams.
